comment: Enthusiastic, helpful, and concise. However, all projects take 10-20 hours to complete. He is a hard grader.

Is extremely nice and keeps class discussions interesting. Will often mock students, which I find unprofessional, but is otherwise a joy to have as a prof. Gives a ton of homework but grades on honest effort/time put into the assignment not on perfection. He has a solution to every educational problem you will ever encounter in your career.
helpful, class was a lot of work but worth it in the end
